description: Check any domain's SSL certificate in one click: validity status, issuer, valid-from and expiry dates, and days remaining.

faqs.a: It reads the domain's live SSL/TLS certificate: who issued it, when it is valid, and how many days remain.
Renew it with your hosting provider or certificate authority (for example Let's Encrypt) to avoid browser security warnings.
faqs.q: What if the certificate is invalid?

faqs.a: Certificates typically expire every 90 days to a year, so check monthly or enable auto-renewal.

howto: Enter the domain you want to check, e.g. example.com.
Click Check SSL to read the domain's live certificate.
Review the validity badge, issuer, dates and days remaining.
Renew or replace the certificate before it expires to avoid browser warnings.
title: SSL Checker
